summary: This bill requires the Secretary of Agriculture, in consultation with the U.S. Trade Representative, to submit an annual report to Congress detailing the competitiveness of U.S. specialty crop exports, including identifying foreign trade barriers and their impacts.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates an annual report on the competitiveness of U.S. specialty crop exports. While preparing and submitting this report will incur some administrative costs, these are minor and incidental to the bill's primary purpose of information gathering, not a significant increase or decrease in government spending.
